d: A new custom motorcycle project pushes Paul Jr.'s creativity and fabrication skills to the limit. The Black Widow, also known as the Spider Bike, features intricate cobweb designs made from dozens of hand-shaped steel rods. Junior and Rick Petko take on the painstaking task of welding these delicate patterns into the frame, fenders, and wheels. Meanwhile, Paul Sr. grows impatient with the slow progress as the workshop deadline approaches. Alongside this demanding project, the crew completes the Carroll Shelby tribute chopper and delivers it to the automotive icon himself. Catch the…
